metadata.source: Canadian Energy Regulator Onshore Pipeline Regulations (SOR/99-294) + Federal Methane Regulations (SOR/2018-66) + AER Directive 071 + Constitution Act, 1982 s.35 (Haida 2004 SCC 73; Tsleil-Waututh 2018 FCA 153)
metadata.sourceLicense: Crown copyright. Federal regulations and AER directives are public regulatory documents reproducible for compliance review under OGL-Canada / OGL-Alberta.
metadata.intendedFor: Review of Canadian onshore pipeline operations manuals, integrity programs, emergency-response programs, and decommissioning plans.

rules.naturalLanguage: A company must develop, implement and maintain a pipeline integrity management program (PIM/IMP) covering threat identification, monitoring, in-line inspection, and corrective action.
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("pipeline integrity management program") || input1.text.Contains("integrity management program") || (input1.text.Contains("PIM") && input1.text.Contains("CER")) || input1.text.Contains("OPR section 40") || input1.text.Contains("OPR s. 40")
rules.remediation: Add to {section.heading}: describe threat identification, ILI cadence, monitoring, and corrective-action triggers, citing CER OPR s. 40.
rules.evidenceQuote: A company shall develop, implement and maintain ... a pipeline integrity management program ...
rules.sourceContent: Canadian Energy Regulator Onshore Pipeline Regulations, SOR/99-294, s. 40. Requires a pipeline integrity management program.

rules.naturalLanguage: A company must develop, implement and maintain an emergency management program that anticipates, prevents, manages and mitigates emergencies. AER Directive 071 imposes equivalent requirements on Alberta operators.
rules.lambda: (input1.text.Contains("emergency management program") || (input1.text.Contains("emergency response plan") && (input1.text.Contains("anticipat") || input1.text.Contains("prevent") || input1.text.Contains("mitigat"))) || input1.text.Contains("Directive 071") || input1.text.Contains("D-071"))
rules.remediation: Add to {section.heading}: include ICS command structure, 24/7 notification matrix, and reference to CER OPR s. 32 (and AER Directive 071 in Alberta).
rules.evidenceQuote: A company shall develop, implement and maintain an emergency management program that anticipates, prevents, manages and mitigates conditions during an emergency ...
rules.sourceContent: CER OPR, SOR/99-294, s. 32(1); AER Directive 071 — Emergency Preparedness and Response Requirements.

rules.naturalLanguage: Federal upstream methane regulations (SOR/2018-66) impose limits on venting and require leak-detection-and-repair (LDAR) programs at upstream oil and gas facilities.
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("SOR/2018-66") || (input1.text.Contains("methane") && input1.text.Contains("LDAR")) || input1.text.Contains("leak detection and repair") || (input1.text.Contains("fugitive emissions") && input1.text.Contains("methane"))
rules.remediation: Add to {section.heading}: describe the LDAR program (component count, screening cadence, repair timeline) and cite SOR/2018-66.
rules.evidenceQuote: An operator of upstream oil and gas facilities must implement a program ... to detect and repair leaks of hydrocarbon gas ...
rules.sourceContent: Regulations Respecting Reduction in the Release of Methane and Certain Volatile Organic Compounds (Upstream Oil and Gas Sector), SOR/2018-66, made under the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999.

rules.naturalLanguage: A documented decommissioning / abandonment plan with demonstrated financial assurance is required before a pipeline or well reaches end of life.
rules.lambda: (input1.text.Contains("decommissioning") || input1.text.Contains("abandonment")) && (input1.text.Contains("financial assurance") || input1.text.Contains("abandonment funding") || input1.text.Contains("Liability Management Rating") || input1.text.Contains("LMR")) && !input1.text.Contains("does not address") && !input1.text.Contains("not addressed") && !input1.text.Contains("not yet established") && !input1.text.Contains("to be filed")
rules.remediation: Add to {section.heading}: an explicit financial-assurance description (CER abandonment-funding mechanism, AER LMR, or BCER equivalent) tied to the decommissioning / abandonment plan.
rules.evidenceQuote: A company shall provide ... mechanisms to ensure that funds are available to pay for abandonment.
rules.sourceContent: CER abandonment-funding mechanism (CER Pipeline Abandonment Cost Estimates regime); AER Directive 011; BCER liability management.

rules.naturalLanguage: Linear energy infrastructure routinely triggers the Crown's duty to consult under s. 35 of the Constitution Act, 1982, as confirmed for energy projects in Tsleil-Waututh Nation v. Canada, 2018 FCA 153.
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("duty to consult") || input1.text.Contains("consultation and accommodation") || (input1.text.Contains("Indigenous") && (input1.text.Contains("section 35") || input1.text.Contains("s. 35") || input1.text.Contains("First Nation")))
rules.remediation: Add to {section.heading}: identify affected nations, summarise consultation activity, and reference the duty to consult under s. 35.
rules.evidenceQuote: The duty to consult ... arises when the Crown has knowledge of the potential existence of an Aboriginal right or title and contemplates conduct that might adversely affect it.
rules.sourceContent: Constitution Act, 1982, s. 35; Haida Nation v. British Columbia, 2004 SCC 73; Tsleil-Waututh Nation v. Canada (Attorney General), 2018 FCA 153.
